defects.observed: R1 global/standardized socket metadata did not match actual openings.
defects.qaEvidence: Round-2 compositor using the exact locked R2 package and PR #3 layout confirms per-asset socket placement works on Regular extremes (including x=0.4551 and x=0.5781) and VIP female variants at both supported aspect-equivalent sizes.

defects.observed: R2 VIP male artwork still contains the original baked facial features around the avatar opening. Example dancer-vip-male-01 leaves the original eyes/hair-face region visibly surrounding the inserted TikTok avatar. This violates avatar-as-identity and is not clean production artwork.
defects.expected: VIP male bodies must expose a clean avatar socket with no baked eyes/nose/mouth/face visible around the composed avatar; hair/costume may frame the socket, but facial identity must come only from the TikTok avatar.
defects.qaEvidence: Exact R2 ZIP SHA 42b2b475...c3559 inspected directly; dancer-vip-male-01 visibly retains the source character eyes above the circular avatar hole.

defects.observed: R1 implementation used crown 0.8x body width and badge 0.42x body width.
defects.expected: Crown 0.44x and rank badge 0.27x body width, positioned relative to the per-asset avatar socket.
defects.qaEvidence: Round-2 compositor confirms the new scale and placement are proportionally appropriate even on strongly off-centre sockets. Any remaining visual contamination seen around crowns comes from the R2 crown artwork itself and is tracked under DA-QA-004, not renderer placement.

defects.observed: R2 still contains source-sheet/tile contamination in production sprites. Confirmed examples: crown-gold and crown-pink retain colored neighboring/background regions; fx-tier5-cosmic-purple contains a visible fragment of the adjacent lower sprite. Several VIP female source crops also show small detached edge fragments outside the intended silhouette.
defects.expected: Every production sprite and atlas frame must be isolated on transparency with no neighboring cell, tile-edge, detached fragment or sheet background contamination.
defects.qaEvidence: Direct inspection of the exact locked R2 package, not fixture images. R2 package hash matches DANCE_LOCK, so this is an asset-pack defect rather than a stale local file.

defects.observed: R1 implementation applied one particleScale-derived coverage formula to all gift tiers.
defects.expected: When largeTakeovers=true, LOW tier-4 coverage >=0.82 stage width and tier-5 >=1.00 stage width; tiers 1-3 remain <=0.62.
defects.qaEvidence: effectCoverage.ts enforces contract floors/cap and pixiRenderer consumes resolved coverage without multiplying particleScale a second time; CI regression suite is green on head 9ac4fab.
